For 20 years as a leader, business partner and entrepreneur, I have been cooperating with companies and employees, bringing above-average benefits to both parties.
On a daily basis, I talk to the owners of technology businesses about their recruitment and needs in the field of building the employer brand (EB) in the Polish market.
I'm the founder of the boutique IT recruitment agency called CandidFuture, a recruiter of managerial and c-level staff, a mentor for IT Recruiters and co-founder of the IT career academy called CandidAcademy.
In 2019, I brought to life the FAIRit - a re-industry program for women under the patronage of infoShare Academy. Thanks to this, 14 out of 19 participants started working as Java or Frontend programmers within three months after finishing.
